name: @redbat/office
description: Fable-compiled office libraries (Word, Spreadsheet, Grid, etc.) for consumption by RedBat frontends.

scripts._restore: dotnet tool restore && for proj in src/Word src/Office.Formats src/Grid src/Spreadsheet src/FableUI; do (cd $proj && dotnet restore >/dev/null); done
scripts.build:fable: dotnet tool restore && rm -rf dist && dotnet fable src/Word --outDir dist/word --lang JavaScript --noCache && dotnet fable src/ShaperText --outDir dist/shaper-text --lang JavaScript --noCache && dotnet fable src/Office.Formats --outDir dist/office-formats --lang JavaScript --noCache && dotnet fable src/Grid --outDir dist/grid --lang JavaScript --noCache && dotnet fable src/Spreadsheet --outDir dist/spreadsheet --lang JavaScript --noCache && dotnet fable src/FableUI --outDir dist/fable-ui --lang JavaScript --noCache
